_about: Settings for kraken_display.py. After editing: systemctl restart kraken-display

modes._help: Picked by CPU load (smoothed, updated every 5 s). At start-up the first 5 s reading sets the mode directly. Up: the load must stay in a higher mode for up_after_min, then it jumps there. Down: it steps through every mode in between, one at a time, spread evenly over down_after_min. load_to: upper load % of the mode. color + lights: hub/RAM light color and brightness %. screen: pump screen brightness %. fan_min / pump_min: minimum duty % for all fans / the pump in this mode. Add, remove or rename modes freely; they're sorted by load_to.

quiet._help: After after_min minutes below load_below % CPU load, all fans go to fan_duty %, the pump to pump_duty %, lights/screen dim, as long as the mode is allowed_up_to or lower; from a higher mode it waits until the mode has stepped down (modes.down_after_min), so the fans cool things off first. at_start: go quiet right away if the first 5 s after starting are idle. Load above load_below for wake_after_min ends it; liquid >= max_liquid or CPU >= max_cpu ends it immediately.

screen._help: rotate: 0/90/180/270. interval: seconds between sensor/fan updates. quiet_brightness: screen % in quiet mode. texts: what the bottom line cycles through, every text_seconds: fans (radiator fan %), next (coming change: next mode, quiet, waking up), pump (pump %), time (clock). Empty ones are skipped.

lights._help: mode: auto (follow the modes) or off. quiet_brightness: % in quiet mode.

dark._help: Lights and pump screen only from the mode show_from up; below it all lights are off and the screen is black (fans keep working). Modes go up only after modes.up_after_min, so short bursts stay dark. show_from: the first mode's name = always on.

fans._help: Curves are [x, duty %] points. radiator/case/pump: x = liquid C; they stay at their minimum up to 34 C and ramp up above it. temp_boost: x = smoothed CPU C. Each fan and the pump run at the highest of their curve, the temp boost and the mode's fan_min/pump_min. ramp_up/ramp_down: max % change per update. NZXT advises against running the pump low for long periods, so it stays at 80 % or more; the Kraken itself won't go below 20 %.
